The '''2024–25 Danish Superliga''' (officially the '''3F Superliga''' for sponsorship purposes) was the 35th season of the [[Danish Superliga]]. [[FC Midtjylland|Midtjylland]] entered the season as the defending champions, having secured the [[2023–24 Danish Superliga|2023–24 title]] on the final day. However, Midtjylland were unable to defend their title as they finished the season in second place, one point behind champions [[F.C. Copenhagen|Copenhagen]].<ref>{{cite web| url=https://bold.dk/fodbold/stillinger/superligaen/nyheder/overlegen-guldsejr-fck-er-dansk-mester| title=Overlegen guldsejr: FCK er dansk mester| publisher=bold.dk| language=da| last1=Nøjsen| first1=Daniel| last2=Porse| first2=Kristian| date=25 May 2025| accessdate=15 June 2025}}</ref>

The schedule for the first seven matchdays was released on 7 June 2024, with the opening fixture set for 19 July between [[Aarhus Gymnastikforening|AGF]] and Midtjylland.<ref>{{cite web| url=https://superliga.dk/nyheder/kamptidspunkter/kampprogrammet-for-grundspillet-2024-25-er-klar| title=Kampprogrammet for Grundspillet 2024-25 er klar| language=da| publisher=Danish Superliga| date=7 June 2024| accessdate=15 June 2025}}</ref> Following the 17th round of fixtures, between 2 December and 14 February, the league entered a winter break in which no league fixtures were played.<ref>{{cite web| url=https://superliga.dk/nyheder/pressemeddelelser/datoplanen-for-2024-25-er-klar| title=Datoplanen for 2024/25 er klar| language=da| publisher=Danish Superliga| date=15 December 2023| accessdate=15 June 2025}}</ref>

==Teams==
[[Sønderjyske Fodbold|Sønderjyske]] won the [[2023–24 Danish 1st Division]] returning to the Superliga after a two-year stint at the lower division,<ref>{{Cite news |title=Hvidovre rykker i Superligaen efter Sønderjyske-dukkert {{!}} Nyheder |url=https://jyllands-posten.dk/sport/fodbold/ECE15910312/hvidovre-rykker-i-superligaen-efter-soenderjyskedukkert/ |access-date=2023-05-29 |website=jyllands-posten |date=28 May 2023 |language=da-DK}}</ref> and [[AaB Fodbold|AaB]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Hvidovre IF rykker op i Superligaen {{!}} Nyheder |url=https://ekstrabladet.dk/sport/fodbold/dansk_fodbold/hvidovre-if-rykker-op-i-superligaen/9785267 |access-date=2023-05-29 |website=ekstrabladet |date=28 May 2023 |language=da-DK}}</ref> made an immediate return to the top flight by finishing second in the 1st Division. Those two teams replaced [[Odense Boldklub|OB]] and [[Hvidovre IF|Hvidovre]], making it the first time since the 1999–2000 season that [[Odense Boldklub|OB]] would not play in the top tier division.

==European play-offs==
The 3rd-placed team of the championship round advances to a play-off match against the winning team of the qualification round (no. 7) in a single-leg tie, with the team from the championship round as hosts. The winner earns a place in the [[2025–26 UEFA Conference League#Second qualifying round|Conference League second qualifying round]].

===Annual awards===
On 23 May 2025, the Superliga announced the Player of the Year award, as well as Young Player of the Year. This was followed by the Team of the Year announcement on 1 June, and Goal of the Year awarded on 3 June.<ref>{{cite web| url=https://superliga.dk/nyheder/arets-mal/24-25/dario-osorio-scorede-arets-mal-2024-25| title=Dario Osorio scorede Årets Mål 2024-25| trans-title=Dario Osorio scored the Goal of the Year 2024-25| language=da| date=4 June 2025| accessdate=4 June 2025}}</ref>
